name: Charles Goerens - Proposition de résolution de remplacement - Am 1
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to do more to fund development ahead of a major United Nations conference in Seville. It asks for fairer treatment of poor countries crushed by debt, including a United Nations framework for restructuring sovereign debt and, in some cases, cancelling it outright. It also asks for more aid, stronger action against tax avoidance, and more say for poorer countries in global financial institutions. The report is a set of recommendations, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the EU and its member states.
- **Who it affects:** Poor and indebted countries, EU aid budgets, and global tax and debt rules.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests at the Seville conference.
